analysis:
Integration pass over a docs-plus-allowlist PR. The only code-affecting change is LaunchAgent.swift (patch near head lines 332 and 375). It adds SSDPrefixCachePolicy.incrementalCheckpointsFlag (DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE_SSD_INCREMENTAL_CHECKPOINTS) to inferencePassthroughEnvKeys. The test in LaunchAgentRestartTests.swift (head ~336-359) pins that the key is forwarded to the provider job, is not in WatchdogAgent.passthroughEnvKeys, and that an unrelated secret is excluded. Docs are updated in changelog.d/delta-complete-checkpoints.md:3, docs/provider/cli-reference.md:1960, docs/reference/configuration.md:685 and docs/reference/ssd-kv-cache.md:311-316. Docs and code agree on forwarding, so the earlier concern about doc/code mismatch is resolved by the LaunchAgent.swift patch.

Security effect: the knob is an operator-controlled, rollback-only switch between delta and complete checkpoint writes (T-041, TB-007, A-001). It does not touch DBK3 crypto, AAD, HMAC lookup tags, the 30-minute TTL, disk budget, salt scoping or the DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE kill switch. The allowlist stays explicit. Test-root and persistent-key controls remain unforwarded and no secrets are added. Anyone who can set the launchd environment is already the local operator (TB-003/ADV-001). The watchdog does not receive the key. No new attack surface or weakened mitigation is identified.

Coverage limit: the delta-checkpoint write/read implementation (SSDBlockStore, SSDPrefixCache, SSDPrefixCachePolicy) is not in the supplied evidence. Whether delta files keep HMAC-only names, no prompt-derived metadata, AAD binding to the parent and salt, fail-closed reads on a missing or tampered parent, and TTL/LRU/KEK-purge coverage of delta chains is unverified. That feature is a pre-existing default and not changed here. Some of these checks belong to the earlier PR that introduced deltas, and T-041 may need to describe delta chains. This is a recommendation, not a regression finding. The patch is limited to the environment allowlist, a one-line doc, and a test; 32 replay units were omitted from the integration source.
